card.name: Just before a person's name in local history
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right before a historical person's name, in local or family history of early settlers, builders and owners (e.g. 'built by', 'home of', 'married').

modes.label: Builder or owner link
modes.description: A word like by, of, or a comma that introduces who built or owned a historic house or mill.
modes.example: The house at Grovelands was built in 1797 to designs by John Nash for the Quaker brewer<<,>> Walker Gray.

modes.label: First settler or marriage
modes.description: A verb or 'and' leading to the name of a settler, newborn or spouse.
modes.example: he<< married>> Frances Sarah Brown, from the nearby village

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward old-fashioned first names like Joshua, Benjamin and Abraham, and away from Chinese characters.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before an early settler's or owner's first name in local history.
